description: This file defines the LogoutController class responsible for handling logout requests by validating OAuth2 tokens and invoking the LogoutService to perform logout operations.

classes.name: LogoutController
classes.description: Controller handling user logout by validating OAuth tokens and invoking logout service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the LogoutController with dependencies LogoutService and ResourceServer.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the logout request by validating the access token, calling the logout service, and returning an appropriate response.
